model_reviewer.summary: The frames show a chest-supported prone dumbbell row on an incline bench. Both arms start hanging straight and both elbows flex to bring the dumbbells to the sides at the top. Bilateral laterality, open-chain, and the horizontal_pull family all fit. Scapular retraction, elbow flexion, and glenohumeral extension as primary actions match the instructions and the visible path, and the lats, rhomboids, middle trapezius, posterior deltoid, teres major, biceps, brachialis, and brachioradialis come out as primary movers. The supported trunk justifies leaving out spinal bracing and postural demands. Grip and wrist_stability correctly sit on the hand-held load. The remaining issues are non-blocking.
